findings: F1 — Candidate Assessment and Consequential Decision Across Both Contexts (Verdict: adopt-local-identity-contract): Retaining the exact current source local digest algorithm, field inclusion, recursive object-key ordering, array order preservation, scalar/numeric serialization, and hex rendering in crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:7-38, crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs:73-90, and crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs:72-91 is sound and appropriate for adoption as a public observational contract (resolving M03 in MISSING-PREMISES.json) across both independent contexts: (1) local runtime stage admission and continuation identity matching in mori_core::stage, and (2) offline independent custodian hand-derivation of canonical Program and StagePlan preimages and SHA-256 digests once the parallel AST/layout/cost premises (M01, M02, M07) are adopted. Retaining the existing encoding requires zero changes to existing hashes or the 88 focused Rust test captures (docs/CORE-CONTINUATIONS.md:8-55) and stays strictly within a local diagnostic identity boundary without implying cryptographic commitment, signature verification, or ZKIRv3/Midnight proof validity.

F2 — Trace of stage::load -> plan::build -> cost::fill -> digest::program_hash -> digest::plan_hash: In crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs:73-90, stage::load(src) executes the following exact pipeline: (1) parser::parse_v2(src) constructs the in-memory crate::Program (crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:179-187); (2) profile::require_core2(&program) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/profile.rs:26-31) enforces program.language == "moriarty/2" and program.semantics == "moriarty-core/2"; (3) validate::validate_v2(&program) checks static Core2 admission rules; (4) plan::build(&program) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/plan.rs:59-125) constructs a StagePlan with format: "moriarty-stage-plan/1", an initially empty program_hash: "", and one ActionPlan per action in program.actions with populated statement_count and sites (Vec<AwaitSite>) but empty segment_cost: [], committed_before: [], and plan_total: UInt(0); (5) validate::plan_invariants(&program, &plan) checks layout invariants; (6) cost::fill(&program, &mut plan) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/cost.rs:120-151) mutates each ActionPlan in place prior to hashing, filling segment_cost (length sites.len() + 1), committed_before (length sites.len() + 1, starting at UInt(0) and accumulating prefix sums of segment_cost), and plan_total (sum of all segment_cost entries); (7) validate::cost_invariants(&program, &plan) verifies static cost invariants; (8) digest::program_hash(&program) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:20-22) computes Sha256::digest(intent::canonical(&program)?); (9) plan.program_hash = digest::hex(&program_hash) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs:82) writes the 64-character lowercase ASCII hex string of program_hash into plan.program_hash; and (10) digest::plan_hash(&plan) (crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:25-38) asserts that plan.program_hash is populated with 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters ([0-9a-f]{64}) and computes Sha256::digest(intent::canonical(&plan)?) over the fully populated StagePlan.

F3 — Trace of intent::canonical Recursion, UTF-8/String Escaping, Numeric Serialization, and Raw Preimage Bytes: In crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs:72-91, intent::canonical<T: Serialize>(value: &T) converts value to serde_json::Value via serde_json::to_value, applies recursive sort(v) converting every serde_json::Value::Object map through std::collections::BTreeMap<String, serde_json::Value> while leaving every serde_json::Value::Array in its exact sequence order (recursively sorting elements), and serializes the resulting value to compact UTF-8 bytes via serde_json::to_vec. Exact byte-level rules: (a) No domain prefix, NUL separator, length header, BOM, or trailing newline is added to the preimage bytes passed to SHA-256 (unlike intent::signing_message in crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs:194-203, which prepends b"moriarty-owner-intent/2\0" and a 4-byte big-endian u32 length); (b) Object keys at every nesting level are ordered by Rust String Ord (lexicographical UTF-8 byte / Unicode scalar value order), overriding Rust struct field declaration order; (c) Compact JSON punctuation uses ":" and "," with zero spaces or newlines; (d) Strings are UTF-8 encoded inside double quotes with standard serde_json compact escaping (\" \\ \b \f \n \r \t and \u00xx for other control bytes 0x00..=0x1F; non-ASCII Unicode characters remain literal UTF-8 bytes); (e) UInt(u128) (crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:13-18) serializes via custom Serialize as a JSON string of canonical base-10 ASCII digits ("0" or nonzero without leading zeros), whereas u16 (ExprId in ir.rs:52, AwaitSite.site, AwaitSite.ordinal, CaptureSlot.ordinal, ActionPlan.statement_count in stage/plan.rs:18-45) and u8 (AssetId.scale in ir.rs:110) serialize as bare JSON integer tokens, and bool serializes as bare true/false; (f) SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) produces a 32-byte digest rendered via intent::hex (intent.rs:89-91) as 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters ([0-9a-f]{64}).

F4 — Normative Observational Clause Text for Core2 Local Program and StagePlan Digests (Resolving M03):
1. Scope and Qualification: Core2 program_hash and plan_hash are deterministic local observational digests over in-memory Program and StagePlan structures (qualification="local-reference-stage", authentication="none", consumption="untracked"). They carry no cryptographic signature, owner authorization, replay protection, or proof/ledger validity.
2. Canonical JSON Byte Encoding (canonical_bytes): For any serializable value V, canonical_bytes(V) is the compact UTF-8 JSON byte sequence produced by converting V to a JSON value tree, recursively sorting the members of every JSON object in strictly ascending lexicographical UTF-8 byte order of their keys while preserving the element order of every JSON array, and formatting with no insignificant whitespace, no domain-separation prefix, no length prefix, and no trailing newline.
3. Scalar and Enum Encoding: Strings use standard RFC 8259 / serde_json compact UTF-8 escaping. UInt values (128-bit unsigned integers) encode as JSON strings matching ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$. Fixed-width integers u16 (ExprId, site, ordinal, statement_count) and u8 (scale) encode as bare JSON numbers matching ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$. Booleans encode as bare true or false. Type encodes as "UInt" or "Bool"; Origin encodes as "Input", "Let", or "Event"; BinaryOp encodes as "Add", "Sub", "Mul", "Eq", "Ne", "Lt", "Le", "Gt", "Ge", "And", or "Or".
4. Canonical Program Preimage and program_hash: The Program preimage is canonical_bytes(Program) over the complete admitted Program object with root keys in exact order ["actions","assets","expressions","language","name","semantics","states"], where language is "moriarty/2" and semantics is "moriarty-core/2". Nested objects have sorted keys: AssetDecl ["identity","name"]; AssetId ["issuer","network","reference","scale"]; StateDecl ["initial","name","ty"]; Value ["type","value"]; InputDecl ["name","ty"]; Action ["inputs","name","statements"]; Expr by variant ("LiabilityPresent" | "LiabilityAmount" | "Name" -> ["kind","name"]; "Literal" -> ["kind","value"]; "Binary" -> ["kind","lhs","op","rhs"]; "Not" -> ["kind","value"]); Statement by variant ("Await" -> ["binders","guard","kind","label"]; "Let" -> ["kind","name","value"]; "Requires" | "Ensures" -> ["kind","predicate"]; "Next" -> ["kind","state","value"]; "Emit" -> ["kind","name","value"]; "Transfer" | "Fee" -> ["amount","asset","from","kind","to"]; "Liability" -> ["amount","asset","creditor","debtor","kind","name"]; "Discharge" -> ["amount","kind","name"]). program_hash is SHA256(canonical_bytes(Program)) rendered as 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters.
5. Canonical StagePlan Preimage and plan_hash: Before computing plan_hash, StagePlan MUST have format set to "moriarty-stage-plan/1", program_hash set to the 64-character lowercase hex string of program_hash(Program), and every ActionPlan in actions populated with its complete sites layout and static cost fields (segment_cost, committed_before, plan_total). The StagePlan preimage is canonical_bytes(StagePlan) with root keys in exact order ["actions","format","program_hash"] and nested keys in exact order: ActionPlan ["action","committed_before","plan_total","segment_cost","sites","statement_count"]; AwaitSite ["binders","captures","label","ordinal","site"]; StageBinder ["name","ty"]; CaptureSlot ["name","ordinal","origin","ty"]. plan_hash is SHA256(canonical_bytes(StagePlan)) rendered as 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters.

F5 — Explicit Security Boundary — What Is and Is Not Bound: Matching program_hash and plan_hash in a Continuation or test artifact binds ONLY the static admitted Program representation and the static cost-filled StagePlan layout. It does NOT bind or authenticate: (1) Work budgets or meter history: continuation.logical.cap is outside both program_hash and plan_hash and can be edited, removed, or raised by an untrusted caller without digest detection (docs/CORE-CONTINUATIONS.md:132-140); continuation.logical.committed is checked on resume only for numeric equality against the static planned prefix entry plan.committed_before[site] (crates/mori-core/src/stage/cost.rs:209-210), proving neither that the prefix was actually executed nor how much attempted work was spent on prior false guards or rejected resumes; (2) Runtime captures and boundary state: StagePlan binds only static CaptureSlot declarations (name, ty, origin, ordinal), whereas continuation.captures (runtime Vec<NamedValue> values), continuation.site, continuation.action, and continuation.boundary (Snapshot of state, balances, and liabilities) are unauthenticated caller-supplied inputs on resume; (3) Event inputs and execution history: StageEvent values are caller-chosen and unauthenticated, and StageSegment / Execution step traces and effects are output-only diagnostics never decoded or verified on resume (crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs:145-153); (4) Replay, consumption, and authority: continuations are untracked and reusable any number of times, and Core2 programs are rejected by the /1 OwnerIntent signing/verification path (crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs:135, 207).

F6 — Preserved Security-Relevant Ambiguities and Structural Observations (Not Auto-Fixed): (1) Unframed JSON Hashing vs. Framed Signing Messages: stage::digest hashes raw intent::canonical JSON bytes with no domain tag, sharing the exact encoding used by the /3 backend program hash (crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs:1-2), whereas intent::signing_message frames OwnerIntent with b"moriarty-owner-intent/2\0" plus a 4-byte big-endian length prefix; domain separation between Program and StagePlan relies solely on their disjoint top-level JSON schemas; (2) Full Expression Arena Inclusion vs. Reachable-Node Costing: program_hash covers the entire Program.expressions vector in index order, whereas cost::expression_nodes (crates/mori-core/src/stage/cost.rs:23-47) counts only distinct nodes reachable from statement roots per statement; thus any parser change to node allocation order or deduplication changes program_hash (and consequently plan_hash) even if reachable per-statement node counts and segment_cost remain invariant; (3) Mixed Indexing Basis of CaptureSlot.ordinal (crates/mori-core/src/stage/plan.rs:68-107): plan::build sets CaptureSlot.ordinal to the 0-based input index in action.inputs for Origin::Input, to the 0-based statement index in action.statements for Origin::Let, and to the enclosing Await statement's 0-based statement index in action.statements for ALL binders of that Await under Origin::Event (so multiple binders at the same Await share the same ordinal); außerdem, an AwaitSite's captures vector snapshots captures accumulated strictly before that Await, appending that Await's own event binders only for subsequent AwaitSites; (4) Asymmetric Serialization Wire (crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs:118-122, 454-465): Core2 Program and Statement implement Serialize (including Statement::Await) for digesting and reporting, but their Deserialize implementations route through ir::v1 which rejects Await, and StagePlan/ActionPlan/AwaitSite do not implement Deserialize.

F7 — Exact Premises Needed for Independent Custodian Derivation Without Deriving Escrow Test Outputs: Adopting the M03 digest contract is necessary but not sufficient by itself to freeze the concrete escrow test Program/StagePlan preimages or report outputs in MISSING-PREMISES.json. To hand-derive the exact Program and StagePlan preimages and SHA-256 digests without reading parser/plan-builder output, the custodian still requires adopted public decisions for: (a) M01 (Core2 parser source-to-expression-arena allocation, node ordering, and sharing/deduplication rules for the five Name occurrences in delivery.mori, which determine Program.expressions, statement ExprId fields, and reachable node counts); (b) M02 (public adoption of the StagePlan layout addressing rules observed in stage/plan.rs: 1-based AwaitSite.site, 0-based statement index AwaitSite.ordinal, and the Origin-dependent 0-based input vs. statement index rules for CaptureSlot.ordinal); and (c) M07 (public adoption of the Core2 reference logical cost schedule observed in stage/cost.rs: 1 + distinct reachable expression nodes per statement, +1 await entry charge at segment exit, committed_before prefix sums, and plan_total). Separately, M04 (per-statement Step.value, await step presence, and effect-delta rules), M05 (complete per-status public JSON report envelope key/null projection), and M06 (exact stdout pretty/compact byte rendering and newline rules) do not affect program_hash or plan_hash, but remain required to freeze the three public report envelopes and stdout byte hashes. Per the stopping rule, no escrow test preimages or hashes are derived or guessed here.

agreedRequiredFields.summary: Independent security review (Gemini 4 Argon (High), authorized outage fallback after Opus 4.8 rate failure at 06:54:51 UTC) of the Core2 local Program and StagePlan digest encoding across both independent contexts (local runtime stage continuation matching and offline custodian preimage/hash derivation for MISSING-PREMISES.json M03). Verdict: adopt-local-identity-contract. Retaining the exact current source encoding in crates/mori-core/src/stage/digest.rs, crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs, crates/mori-core/src/stage/plan.rs, crates/mori-core/src/stage/cost.rs, crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs, and crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs is sound, deterministic, and backward-compatible with existing hashes. Both program_hash and plan_hash compute SHA-256 over the unframed compact UTF-8 JSON bytes produced by intent::canonical (recursive BTreeMap lexicographical UTF-8 key sorting on all JSON objects, preserved JSON array order, UInt serialized as canonical ASCII decimal strings, u16/u8 as bare JSON numbers, and 64-character lowercase hex output), with plan.program_hash (64-char hex) and static cost arrays (segment_cost, committed_before, plan_total) filled into StagePlan before plan_hash is computed. This contract strictly binds only the static Program and static StagePlan; it provides zero authentication of logical.cap, logical.committed execution history, runtime captures values, boundary snapshots, StageEvent inputs, or continuation replay/consumption, and implies no OwnerIntent signature or ZKIRv3/Midnight proof authority. Complete offline derivation of the escrow test Program/StagePlan hashes additionally requires adopting the parallel ordinary premises M01 (expression arena allocation/sharing), M02 (layout/capture ordinal rules), and M07 (logical cost schedule), while report envelopes/bytes require M04-M06.
